styles.name: Card Grid
styles.brief: Real admin shell with white sidebar, white top bar, gray-blue workspace, KPI cards, quick entries, filters, dense tables, and utility panels.
styles.zhBrief: 真实后台外壳、白色侧栏、白色顶栏、灰蓝工作区、指标卡、快捷入口、筛选栏、密集表格和工具面板。
styles.bestFor: admin panels, enterprise consoles, permission systems, operations dashboards
styles.zhBestFor: 后台管理、企业控制台、权限系统、运营仪表盘
notes: Start with the admin application frame: sidebar, top bar, breadcrumb or tabs, workspace, and table-first modules.
Use search, filters, KPI cards, quick entries, ranking lists, calendars, approvals, and dense tables as real management anchors.
Avoid hero sections, decorative card walls, oversized marketing typography, and abstract product art.

scenario.headline: Run the daily admin workspace from one dense console.
scenario.lede: A practical enterprise admin page with persistent navigation, searchable records, KPI cards, quick entries, tables, rankings, approvals, and calendar widgets.
features: Application shell first
Sidebar modules, top search, page tabs, and workspace panels establish a real system before any decorative styling.
Operational density
KPI cards, quick actions, filters, tables, charts, rankings, approvals, and schedules share one scan-friendly grid.
Admin-specific states
Selected menu items, disabled tools, empty states, warning rows, approval tabs, and row actions stay visible.

launch: Task review
Filter task records, inspect owner/status columns, and keep empty or warning states inside the table frame.
metrics: Compare annual value, record count, opportunities, signed orders, ranking lists, and approval tabs.
assets: System modules
Use records, purchasing, products, workflow, reports, monitoring, permissions, and settings sections as real navigation.

playbook.name: Blue Admin Console
playbook.structure: Full admin application shell: white sidebar, white top bar, breadcrumb/tab strip, gray-blue workspace, KPI row, quick entries, chart cards, ranking panel, approval/calendar widgets, and a dense data table.
playbook.zhStructure: 完整后台应用外壳：白色侧栏、白色顶栏、面包屑/标签、灰蓝工作区、指标卡行、快捷入口、图表卡、排行面板、审批/日程组件和密集数据表。
playbook.typography: Use compact sans-serif UI text, practical section titles, tabular numerals, muted labels, and table-first hierarchy instead of hero-scale headings.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用紧凑非衬线界面字体、实用分区标题、表格数字、弱化标签和表格优先层级，不使用首屏大标题。
playbook.components: Persistent sidebar navigation, top search, icon buttons, account menu, active tabs, KPI cards, shortcut tiles, filter toolbar, date range controls, status chips, data tables, charts, approval tabs, ranking lists, and calendar strips should feel like one admin system.
playbook.zhComponents: 固定侧边导航、顶部搜索、图标按钮、账户菜单、激活标签、指标卡、快捷入口、筛选工具条、日期范围控件、状态标签、数据表、图表、审批标签、排行列表和日程条应属于同一个后台系统。
playbook.buttons: Primary buttons are practical solid controls; secondary actions stay quiet as bordered controls.
playbook.zhButtons: 主按钮是务实的实色控件，次级操作保持低调边框样式。
playbook.media: Use real interface evidence: table rows, chart grids, ranked lists, empty states, approval panes, calendars, and product screenshots instead of abstract hero art.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用真实界面证据：表格行、图表网格、排行列表、空状态、审批面板、日历和产品截图，不使用抽象主视觉。
playbook.states: Show selected sidebar item, active tab, search/filter state, pending approvals, warning rows, empty tables, disabled tools, loading rows, and focus rings clearly.
playbook.zhStates: 清楚呈现侧栏选中项、激活标签、搜索/筛选状态、待审批、警告行、空表格、禁用工具、加载行和焦点环。
playbook.avoid: Do not use marketing hero sections, oversized display copy, decorative card walls, abstract dashboards, or isolated cards without navigation context.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要使用营销首屏、超大展示文案、装饰性卡片墙、抽象仪表盘，或缺少导航上下文的孤立卡片。

geometry.description: real admin shell geometry with compact panels, dense rows, and precise controls

implementation.buttons: Use compact blue primary buttons, quiet bordered secondary buttons, square icon tools, tab buttons, and stable loading buttons inside the top bar or table toolbar.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用紧凑蓝色主按钮、低调描边次按钮、方形图标工具、标签按钮，以及在顶栏或表格工具条内保持宽度稳定的加载按钮。
implementation.feedback: Use selected sidebar states, active tabs, row-local warnings, small status toasts, empty table states, pending chips, and disabled tools in the same admin language.
implementation.zhFeedback: 用同一套后台语言呈现侧栏选中、激活标签、行内警告、小型状态 toast、空表格、待处理标签和禁用工具。
implementation.spacing: Use a 220-260px sidebar, 56-72px top bar, 16-20px workspace gutters, 14-18px panel padding, 8-12px row gaps, and 40-44px controls for repeated scanning.
implementation.zhSpacing: 侧栏 220-260px，顶栏 56-72px，工作区留白 16-20px，面板内边距 14-18px，行间距 8-12px，控件 40-44px，适合反复扫描。
implementation.responsive: Desktop keeps sidebar, top bar, KPI row, chart/ranking panels, and table visible; tablet collapses right panels below; mobile turns sidebar into a horizontal module strip and makes tables horizontally scrollable.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面保留侧栏、顶栏、指标行、图表/排行面板和表格；平板把右侧面板下移；手机把侧栏变成横向模块条，并让表格可横向滚动。

adaptation.landing: Use only when the public page needs to show an actual admin product screenshot; the screenshot should still include sidebar, top bar, tables, filters, and widgets.
adaptation.dashboard: Use a real app shell with white sidebar, top search, page tabs, KPI row, quick entries, chart cards, ranking lists, approval panes, and calendar widgets.
adaptation.admin: Use compact tables, toolbar filters, date ranges, bulk actions, column settings, row-level status, empty states, permission controls, and detail drawers.
adaptation.forms: Use visible labels, compact helper text, grouped sections, inline validation, table-adjacent editing, permission warnings, and save/cancel toolbars.
adaptation.mobile: Turn sidebar navigation into a horizontal module strip, keep the page title and primary action near the top, stack widgets, and make dense tables scroll horizontally.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for expressive fashion, immersive art, or pages that need emotional hero storytelling instead of management clarity.

styles.name: Block Brutalism
styles.brief: Warm yellow canvas, hard black borders, blocky controls, saturated labels, and strong campaign energy.
styles.zhBrief: 暖黄画布、硬黑边框、块状控件、高饱和标签和强活动感。
styles.bestFor: bold campaigns, indie products, playful utilities
styles.zhBestFor: 强品牌活动、独立产品、趣味工具
notes: Use loud hierarchy and hard geometry.
Let tension come from shape and contrast, not randomness.
Keep forms and actions obvious.

scenario.headline: Make the launch impossible to ignore.
scenario.lede: A loud campaign workspace for bold releases, urgent signups, waitlists, and punchy product announcements.
features: Hard hierarchy
Black borders, block labels, and oversized type make the core action unmistakable.
Campaign pressure
Timers, scarcity notes, and status slabs create energy without hiding the rules.
Readable chaos
The grid feels loud, but actions and requirements stay obvious.

launch: Drop control
Lock the headline, ticket rules, and urgency modules before the campaign goes live.
metrics: Track waitlist growth, claim rate, failed attempts, and referral lift during the launch window.
assets: Poster kit
Reuse stickers, stamps, product blocks, and oversized labels across the campaign.

playbook.name: Street Poster Launch
playbook.structure: Poster-first composition with slab headline blocks, ticket strips, hard stamps, and intentionally loud hierarchy.
playbook.zhStructure: 海报优先的构图，包含块状标题、票券条、硬质印章和刻意强烈的层级。
playbook.typography: Use huge block type, compressed labels, blunt numbers, and minimal body copy.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用巨大块状标题、压缩标签、直接数字和很少的正文。
playbook.components: Tickets, stamps, countdowns, rule panels, and claim modules should look physical and direct.
playbook.zhComponents: 票券、印章、倒计时、规则面板和领取模块要有实体感和直接感。
playbook.buttons: Buttons are black or saturated slabs with hard borders and offset shadows, never soft pills.
playbook.zhButtons: 按钮使用黑色或高饱和块面、硬边框和错位阴影，绝不做柔软胶囊。
playbook.media: Use poster blocks, product labels, stickers, or campaign artifacts as the main image language.
playbook.zhMedia: 用海报块、产品标签、贴纸或活动物料作为主视觉语言。
playbook.states: Use stamped states such as live, locked, claimed, expired, and warning with strong contrast.
playbook.zhStates: 用高对比印章状态表达 live、locked、claimed、expired 和 warning。
playbook.avoid: Do not soften the style with generic rounded SaaS cards.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要用通用圆角 SaaS 卡片软化这个风格。

geometry.description: hard square geometry with no softened SaaS corners

implementation.buttons: Use blunt rectangular buttons with thick borders, hard offset shadows, pressed translation, and no soft disabled treatment.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用钝感矩形按钮、粗边框、硬偏移阴影、按下位移，并避免柔和的禁用态。
implementation.feedback: Use poster-like alert strips, stamped success labels, and obvious error blocks with hard borders.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用海报式提示条、印章式成功标签，以及粗边框错误块。
implementation.spacing: Use large 24-32px slabs, abrupt 12-16px gaps, and intentionally chunky control groups.
implementation.zhSpacing: 使用 24-32px 大块内边距、12-16px 明确间距，以及厚重的控件组。
implementation.responsive: Desktop can be asymmetric; tablet collapses poster and proof wall; mobile becomes a single stack with full-width slab buttons and no horizontal overflow.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可以不对称；平板折叠海报和证明墙；手机变成单列，按钮全宽且不能横向溢出。

adaptation.landing: Use a campaign poster, stamped proof, bold offer slab, and one loud call-to-action with hard-edged supporting tickets.
adaptation.dashboard: Use chunky status slabs and urgent queues only for high-energy launch or moderation dashboards.
adaptation.admin: Use blunt forms, strong section borders, and obvious destructive confirmation; keep density lower than a neutral admin shell.
adaptation.forms: Use large labels, hard field borders, poster-like errors, and full-width confirmation blocks.
adaptation.mobile: Stack slabs in a strong reading order; remove side collisions and keep buttons full-width with no horizontal overflow.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for quiet finance, medical, legal, or long-form reading products.

styles.name: Aurora Gradient
styles.brief: Dark canvas, aurora color fields, soft glow, drifting gradient energy, and premium immersive atmosphere.
styles.zhBrief: 暗色画布、极光色场、柔光、漂移渐变能量和高级沉浸氛围。
styles.bestFor: immersive art venues, futuristic products, premium dark experiences
styles.zhBestFor: 沉浸式艺术场馆、未来感产品、高级暗色体验
notes: Use glow as atmosphere around important content.
Keep text panels calm and readable.
Avoid turning every surface into a rainbow gradient.

scenario.headline: Book a quiet room where color, sound, and time move together.
scenario.lede: A late-night art venue page for sound baths, light installations, private listening rooms, and small cultural gatherings.
features: Light as schedule
The aurora field marks session phases, entry time, and room intensity instead of acting as decoration.
Human pace
Capacity, quiet rules, and host notes stay close to the booking action.
Spatial proof
Room map, sound cues, and visitor notes make the page feel like a real venue.

launch: Session booking
Arrange the main object, decision path, and supporting details before polishing the style.
metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.
assets: Sound and light objects
Use visual objects that belong to the scene so the sample feels lived-in and useful.

playbook.name: Aurora Listening Room
playbook.structure: Immersive venue layout with a luminous room field, session rail, capacity notes, and sound-light booking controls.
playbook.zhStructure: 沉浸式场馆布局，包含发光房间场、场次轨、容量说明和声光预约控件。
playbook.typography: Use calm dark UI type, generous line height, small venue metadata, and restrained luminous headings.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用安静暗色界面字体、舒展行高、小型场馆元数据和克制发光标题。
playbook.components: Room fields, session chips, ticket states, host notes, map legends, and quiet booking controls should feel like a real cultural venue.
playbook.zhComponents: 房间场、场次标签、票务状态、主持说明、地图图例和安静预约控件要像真实文化场馆。
playbook.buttons: Primary actions may glow softly; secondary actions stay translucent with clear borders.
playbook.zhButtons: 主操作可轻微发光，次操作保持透明描边且清晰。
playbook.media: Use aurora light, room maps, sound rings, seat notes, and session bands as useful objects.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用极光、房间地图、声波环、座位说明和场次条作为有用对象。
playbook.states: Show open, few seats, private, selected room, check-in soon, and sold-out states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 open、few seats、private、selected room、check-in soon 和 sold-out 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not make the page a generic AI glow dashboard.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要把页面做成通用 AI 发光仪表盘。

geometry.description: restrained aurora panels with crisp controls

implementation.buttons: Use luminous but restrained buttons, translucent secondary controls, and selected states that glow only at the edge.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用克制发光按钮、半透明次级控件，以及只在边缘发光的选中态。
implementation.feedback: Use soft toast panels, score-change alerts, and low-noise validation hints over dark panels.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用柔和 toast、分数变化提示，以及暗色面板上的低噪声校验提示。
implementation.spacing: Use 22-28px glass panel padding, 14px component gaps, and generous breathing room around comparison cards.
implementation.zhSpacing: 玻璃面板内边距 22-28px，组件间距 14px，对比卡周围保持足够呼吸感。
implementation.responsive: Desktop keeps evidence, comparison, and review notes side by side; mobile stacks them as review cards and keeps the score/primary action visible before media.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面并列证据、对比和审阅备注；手机堆叠成审阅卡，并把分数和主操作放在媒体之前。

adaptation.landing: Use a premium dark product narrative with comparison panels, evidence cards, soft media, and restrained glow.
adaptation.dashboard: Use model runs, confidence scores, review notes, and selected-state panels rather than generic dark cards.
adaptation.admin: Use review workflows, validation queues, and low-noise status panels; keep destructive states crisp.
adaptation.forms: Use translucent field groups over stable dark surfaces with clear focus and validation edges.
adaptation.mobile: Show score and primary action before media; stack comparison cards with readable text over every panel.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for dense clerical tools or pages that must feel plain and official.

styles.name: Retro Y2K
styles.brief: Candy gradients, neon details, retro display type, sparkle energy, and early-2000s digital optimism.
styles.zhBrief: 糖果渐变、霓虹细节、复古标题字、星光能量和千禧年数字乐观感。
styles.bestFor: music, fashion, youth culture, playful campaigns
styles.zhBestFor: 音乐、潮流、青年文化、活动页
notes: Use playful shine and neon in controlled zones.
Pair expressive display type with readable body copy.
Keep nostalgia bright, not cluttered.

scenario.headline: Stage the drop, preview tracks, and collect reminders.
scenario.lede: A playable release deck for cover crops, countdowns, track snippets, reminder signups, and launch-day status.
features: Glossy emphasis
Shine, neon outlines, and bubbly forms carry the mood while keeping copy legible.
Hype modules
Track cards, countdowns, artist notes, and badges feel like part of one event.
Controlled sparkle
Decorative energy stays around the primary objects instead of covering the interface.

launch: Release staging
Pin the main drop, support it with track snippets, and keep signup controls easy to find.
metrics: Watch saves, shares, preview plays, and reminder signups as the launch approaches.
assets: Promo pieces
Use cover crops, stickers, badges, and snippets as content, not random decoration.

playbook.name: Glossy Y2K Stage
playbook.structure: A glossy stage with marquee bars, circular media, sticker controls, and a playful release lineup.
playbook.zhStructure: 亮面舞台式布局，包含跑马灯条、圆形媒体、贴纸控件和玩乐发布阵容。
playbook.typography: Pair expressive display words with readable short captions and badge labels.
playbook.zhTypography: 把夸张展示字和可读短说明、徽章标签搭配使用。
playbook.components: Lineup cards, track pills, shiny badges, countdown chips, and signup controls should feel collectible.
playbook.zhComponents: 阵容卡、曲目胶囊、亮面徽章、倒计时标签和注册控件要有收藏感。
playbook.buttons: Buttons are glossy, thick, and high-energy with clear hover and pressed states.
playbook.zhButtons: 按钮要亮面、厚实、有能量，并有清晰 hover 与 pressed 状态。
playbook.media: Use cover art crops, neon frames, sparkles, and real promo fragments.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用封面裁切、霓虹框、星光和真实宣传碎片。
playbook.states: Show queued, live, saved, reminder-on, and preview-playing states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 queued、live、saved、reminder-on 和 preview-playing 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not let sparkle effects cover interface meaning.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要让星光效果盖过界面含义。

geometry.description: glossy Y2K shapes without default pill buttons

implementation.buttons: Use glossy compact buttons, bright pill-like chips only for real states, and active feedback that feels like a music player control.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用有光泽的紧凑按钮，只在真实状态上使用亮色 chip，按下反馈像音乐播放器控件。
implementation.feedback: Use energetic launch toasts, live/reminder badges, and inline signup confirmation.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用有活力的发布 toast、live/reminder 徽章，以及内联报名确认。
implementation.spacing: Use 18-24px stage padding, 8-12px pill gaps, and compact countdown blocks.
implementation.zhSpacing: 舞台内边距 18-24px，胶囊间距 8-12px，倒计时块保持紧凑。
implementation.responsive: Desktop may use a stage and control panel; mobile moves lineup, countdown, and signup into a single sequenced flow.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可使用舞台和控制面板；手机把 lineup、倒计时和报名变成单列流程。

adaptation.landing: Use a glossy stage, lineup, countdown, signup module, and collectible media fragments.
adaptation.dashboard: Use launch signals, reminder counts, live badges, and compact activity strips for campaign operations.
adaptation.admin: Use bright but bounded controls for content scheduling, asset approval, and release checklists.
adaptation.forms: Use compact glossy fields, visible signup confirmation, and playful but readable validation.
adaptation.mobile: Sequence headline, media, countdown, signup, lineup, then proof; avoid tiny pills as primary controls.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for serious enterprise workflows or high-trust official services.

styles.name: Swiss Editorial
styles.brief: Tight editorial grid, red-black typographic hierarchy, rule lines, minimal gutters, and disciplined content rhythm.
styles.zhBrief: 紧凑编辑网格、红黑字体层级、细分割线、极小页边距和克制内容节奏。
styles.bestFor: portfolios, cultural sites, design studios, serious content
styles.zhBestFor: 作品集、文化机构、设计工作室、严肃内容
notes: Let typography and rules create the visual system.
Use red sparingly for hierarchy and urgency.
Avoid soft SaaS cards.

scenario.headline: Index the issue with type, rules, and evidence.
scenario.lede: A publication-grade surface for dense cultural catalogs, source tables, object crops, and editorial proof that must feel objective.
features: Baseline grid
Every headline, caption, and data row locks to a visible publishing rhythm.
Object proof
Image crops, labels, and accession marks sit in the same rule system as the copy.
Index table
Readers can scan issue entries without losing the editorial hierarchy.

launch: Issue layout
Set the masthead, lead article, object board, and source ledger before publishing.
metrics: Compare saves, scroll depth, source opens, and return visits across editorial paths.
assets: Archive media
Use object crops, captions, and document fragments only when they support the evidence.

playbook.name: Swiss Archive Board
playbook.structure: Objective issue board with masthead rules, accession numbers, object crops, dense source rows, and a visible modular grid.
playbook.zhStructure: 客观期刊索引板，包含刊头规则线、藏品编号、对象裁切、密集来源行和可见模块网格。
playbook.typography: Use grotesk type, tabular numerals, uppercase labels, strict alignment, and oversized issue numbers.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用 grotesk 字体、等宽数字、大写标签、严格对齐和超大期号。
playbook.components: Mastheads, object boards, accession rows, source ledgers, issue metrics, and compact text actions define the page.
playbook.zhComponents: 刊头、对象板、藏品行、来源账本、期号指标和紧凑文字操作定义页面。
playbook.buttons: Buttons are hard-edged text or rule-line controls that align to the grid.
playbook.zhButtons: 按钮使用硬边文字或规则线控件，并对齐网格。
playbook.media: Use cropped catalog objects, source fragments, accession labels, and table-like evidence blocks.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用目录对象裁切、来源片段、藏品标签和表格式证据块。
playbook.states: Show selected issue, locked index, source-open, caption-needed, saved object, and empty source states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 selected issue、locked index、source-open、caption-needed、saved object 和 empty source 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not let the page collapse into a generic editorial article with sidebars.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要让页面退化成带边栏的通用编辑文章页。

geometry.description: editorial hard edges and rule-line structure

implementation.buttons: Use text-link buttons, underlined actions, rule-line tabs, and almost no filled buttons unless the action is decisive.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用文字链接按钮、下划线操作、规则线 tab，除非动作非常关键，否则少用填充按钮。
implementation.feedback: Use editorial callouts, margin notes, and rule-separated validation messages instead of colored bubbles.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用编辑式 callout、边注和规则线分隔的校验消息，而不是彩色气泡。
implementation.spacing: Use column gutters of 24-32px, strict baselines, thin dividers, and wide reading measures.
implementation.zhSpacing: 列间距 24-32px，严格基线、细分割线和宽阅读区域。
implementation.responsive: Desktop uses columns; tablet narrows metadata into a top strip; mobile preserves reading order with actions under the headline.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面使用分栏；平板把元信息压成顶部条；手机保持阅读顺序，操作放在标题下。

adaptation.landing: Use editorial columns, rule lines, captions, proof excerpts, and understated text actions.
adaptation.dashboard: Use index tables, metadata columns, and structured evidence rather than cards.
adaptation.admin: Use form sections, audit rows, legal/procurement evidence blocks, and rule-line navigation.
adaptation.forms: Use persistent labels, narrow measures, divider-separated validation, and underlined actions.
adaptation.mobile: Preserve reading order: headline, metadata, action, article body, index; avoid hidden sidebars.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for playful commerce, heavy animation, or highly visual immersive demos.

styles.name: Terminal Hacker
styles.brief: Black canvas, terminal green, monospace, CRT scanlines, command-line details, and developer credibility.
styles.zhBrief: 黑色画布、终端绿、等宽字体、CRT 扫描线、命令行细节和开发者可信感。
styles.bestFor: developer tools, CLI products, security, open source
styles.zhBestFor: 开发者工具、CLI、安全、开源
notes: Use monospace rhythm and command metaphors.
Keep scanline or terminal texture subtle.
Make focus and error states unmistakable.

scenario.headline: Trace exposed secrets before they ship.
scenario.lede: A terminal-inspired tool for scanning repos, replaying incidents, and making developer security feel native.
features: Command rhythm
Monospace surfaces, prompts, and log rows make the product feel credible to developers.
Sharp states
Warnings, failures, and successful checks are unmistakable in a dark console.
Useful texture
Scanlines and glow stay subtle so long logs remain readable.

launch: Scan run
Start a scan, group findings by severity, and keep remediation commands one click away.
metrics: Track leak count, time to revoke, watched repos, and ignored warnings.
assets: Evidence log
Keep commit hashes, owners, file paths, and remediation notes in compact rows.

playbook.name: Terminal Console
playbook.structure: Command-line console with log panes, prompt rows, file paths, severity lanes, and a compact run summary.
playbook.zhStructure: 命令行控制台，包含日志面板、提示符行、文件路径、严重级别轨道和紧凑运行摘要。
playbook.typography: Use monospace for the main interface and keep long log rows aligned.
playbook.zhTypography: 主界面使用等宽字体，并保持长日志行对齐。
playbook.components: Prompt inputs, log rows, severity chips, file paths, command buttons, and inline remediation blocks are central.
playbook.zhComponents: 提示符输入、日志行、严重级别标签、文件路径、命令按钮和内联修复块是核心。
playbook.buttons: Buttons should look like executable commands, with brackets, prompt marks, or terminal borders.
playbook.zhButtons: 按钮应像可执行命令，可使用括号、提示符标记或终端边框。
playbook.media: Use logs, code snippets, repo paths, and scan traces instead of abstract graphics.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用日志、代码片段、仓库路径和扫描轨迹，不使用抽象图形。
playbook.states: Show pass, fail, warning, masked, ignored, running, and copied command states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 pass、fail、warning、masked、ignored、running 和 copied command 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not use green glow so heavily that logs become hard to read.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要把绿色发光用到影响日志阅读。

geometry.description: terminal-like square controls and tiny window corners

implementation.buttons: Use command-style buttons, terminal labels, sharp focus rings, and disabled states that look locked rather than faded away.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用命令式按钮、终端标签、锐利焦点环，以及像 locked 而不是淡掉的禁用态。
implementation.feedback: Use log-line alerts, command output toasts, and inline error rows with exact recovery commands.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用日志行提示、命令输出 toast，以及带修复命令的内联错误行。
implementation.spacing: Use 12-18px monospace panels, 8-10px log rows, and compact control groups.
implementation.zhSpacing: 终端面板内边距 12-18px，日志行间距 8-10px，控件组紧凑。
implementation.responsive: Desktop keeps console and severity board split; mobile stacks logs first, then metrics, then secondary evidence.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面拆分控制台和严重度面板；手机先显示日志，再显示指标，再显示次级证据。

adaptation.landing: Use terminal output, command examples, severity proof, and a clear install or run action.
adaptation.dashboard: Use log streams, severity filters, health metrics, command results, and incident queues.
adaptation.admin: Use CLI-like settings, permission warnings, and exact recovery commands for technical operators.
adaptation.forms: Use command labels, sharp focus rings, monospace helper text, and exact error recovery.
adaptation.mobile: Show logs first, then metrics and recovery actions; keep command snippets wrap-safe.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for consumer lifestyle, soft wellness, or image-led brand storytelling.

styles.name: Cute-alism
styles.brief: Soft playful surfaces, friendly object shapes, pastel accents, compact controls, and warm task-board clarity.
styles.zhBrief: 柔和玩乐表面、友好对象形状、粉彩点缀、紧凑控件和温暖任务板层级。
styles.bestFor: playful productivity, education tools, creator utilities
styles.zhBestFor: 玩乐生产力、教育工具、创作者实用工具
notes: Use cute objects as workflow anchors, not decoration.
Keep controls chunky but calm enough for daily use.
Balance pastel warmth with readable operational detail.

scenario.headline: Turn small lessons, chores, and creator tasks into a calm daily board.
scenario.lede: A cute but useful workspace for classroom check-ins, tiny milestones, reward tokens, gentle reminders, and finished work.
features: Cute workflow
Soft objects mark real states such as next, blocked, finished, and reward-ready.
Daily clarity
The board keeps today, later, and reward notes visible without becoming a dense admin table.
Friendly feedback
Pastel panels and chunky controls make progress feel encouraging while labels stay clear.

launch: Daily planning
Arrange lessons, errands, and creator tasks into one friendly board.
metrics: Track completed tasks, reward tokens, review streaks, and skipped items.
assets: Reward shelf
Use icons, badges, notes, and soft objects as functional progress cues.

playbook.name: Cute Daily Desk
playbook.structure: Playful task desk with today lanes, reward shelf, sticky notes, soft objects, and compact progress controls.
playbook.zhStructure: 玩乐任务桌面，包含今日泳道、奖励架、便签、柔和对象和紧凑进度控件。
playbook.typography: Use friendly bold headings, short task labels, and calm readable status text.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用友好粗标题、短任务标签和安静可读的状态文字。
playbook.components: Task tiles, reward tokens, progress meters, note pads, and friendly state chips should be tactile but useful.
playbook.zhComponents: 任务块、奖励 token、进度条、便签和友好状态 chip 要有触感且有用。
playbook.buttons: Buttons are chunky, softly outlined, playful, and clearly clickable without neon glare.
playbook.zhButtons: 按钮厚实、柔和描边、有玩乐感，并且显然可点击但不刺眼。
playbook.media: Use soft object shapes, note cards, badges, and task-board cues as workflow anchors.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用柔和对象形状、便签、徽章和任务板线索作为流程锚点。
playbook.states: Show next, done, ready, skipped, reward-ready, and gentle blocked states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 next、done、ready、skipped、reward-ready 和温和 blocked 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not let cuteness remove workflow clarity or make the palette painfully bright.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要让可爱感削弱流程清晰度，也不要让配色刺眼。

geometry.description: playful sticker curves with hard-shadow contrast

implementation.buttons: Use sticker-like buttons with firm shadows, playful active motion, and high-contrast disabled labels.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用贴纸感按钮、明确阴影、俏皮按下动效和高对比禁用标签。
implementation.feedback: Use friendly shop toasts, cart confirmations, and inline proof states that feel tactile.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用友好的商店 toast、购物车确认，以及有触感的内联 proof 状态。
implementation.spacing: Use 18-24px playful padding, 12-16px sticker gaps, and irregular but aligned product zones.
implementation.zhSpacing: 使用 18-24px 俏皮内边距、12-16px 贴纸间距，以及不完全规整但对齐的商品区域。
implementation.responsive: Desktop can show builder plus catalog; mobile puts builder first, then product cards, then cart summary.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面显示构建器加目录；手机先构建器，再商品卡，最后购物车摘要。

adaptation.landing: Use a playful product builder, sticker-like media, price/proof tags, and a friendly cart action.
adaptation.dashboard: Use creator shop metrics, order states, fulfillment cards, and tactile product previews.
adaptation.admin: Use readable commerce controls, variant forms, inventory warnings, and friendly confirmation states.
adaptation.forms: Use chunky labels, tactile inputs, high-contrast validation, and clear cart/save feedback.
adaptation.mobile: Put builder first, then product cards, cart summary, and proof; keep playful elements from crowding controls.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for sober B2B, dense analytics, or official documentation portals.

styles.name: Resonant Stark
styles.brief: Near-black canvas, thin type, subtle glow, extreme whitespace, delicate lines, and premium restraint.
styles.zhBrief: 近黑画布、细字重、微光、大留白、精细线条和高级克制感。
styles.bestFor: photography archives, premium dark portfolios, art, high-end product teasers
styles.zhBestFor: 摄影档案、高级暗色作品集、艺术、精品预告页
notes: Use quiet space as the main visual move.
Keep glow delicate and premium.
Let content breathe instead of filling every gap.

scenario.lede: A stark photography studio page for exhibition proofs, silver gelatin prints, darkroom notes, and collector inquiries.
features: Contact first
The proof sheet becomes the main interface, with frame numbers and selected marks doing real work.
Private inquiry
Collector action stays precise and quiet rather than commercial.
Print evidence
Paper type, crop choice, and darkroom notes sit beside the selected frame.

Arrange the main object, decision path, and supporting details before polishing the style.
metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.

Use visual objects that belong to the scene so the sample feels lived-in and useful.

playbook.name: Stark Photo Contact Sheet
playbook.structure: Monochrome archive layout with a contact sheet, selected frame, print ledger, darkroom notes, and sparse inquiry action.
playbook.zhStructure: 黑白档案布局，包含联系印样、选中画面、印制账本、暗房笔记和稀疏询问操作。
playbook.typography: Use thin type, frame numbers, narrow captions, and table-like print metadata.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用细字重、画面编号、窄图注和表格式印制元数据。
playbook.components: Contact frames, crop marks, print rows, inquiry cells, and darkroom notes should stay quiet and exact.
playbook.zhComponents: 联系印样框、裁切标记、印制行、询问单元和暗房笔记应保持安静精准。
playbook.buttons: Use quiet text or outline actions with precise focus states.
playbook.zhButtons: 使用安静文字或描边操作，并提供精准焦点态。
playbook.media: Use frame grids, proof marks, print paper labels, and darkroom process notes.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用画面网格、校样标记、相纸标签和暗房过程说明。
playbook.states: Show selected, proof ready, draft note, private inquiry, and edition closed states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 selected、proof ready、draft note、private inquiry 和 edition closed 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not fill the silence with equal dark cards.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要用等权暗色卡片填满安静感。

geometry.description: stark near-square panels and thin editorial controls

implementation.buttons: Use restrained text buttons or hard-edged outline controls; keep hover/focus precise and quiet.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用克制文字按钮或硬边描边控件；hover/focus 精确而安静。
implementation.feedback: Use sparse status notes, subtle border changes, and no decorative alert noise.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用稀疏状态说明、细微边框变化，避免装饰性提示噪声。
implementation.spacing: Use large negative space, 28-40px object gutters, and sparse metadata rows.
implementation.zhSpacing: 使用大面积留白、28-40px 对象间距和稀疏元信息行。
implementation.responsive: Desktop may hold an object stage beside notes; mobile places the object first, then proof rows and one clear action.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可让对象舞台和说明并列；手机先对象，再证明行，最后一个明确操作。

adaptation.landing: Use one object, one message, sparse proof rows, and a restrained action with premium whitespace.
adaptation.dashboard: Use only for high-end monitoring or portfolio dashboards where a single object/state matters most.
adaptation.admin: Use sparse review panels, minimal metadata, and precise outline controls; avoid dense bulk workflows.
adaptation.forms: Use few fields, large whitespace, clear labels, and quiet validation with strong contrast.
adaptation.mobile: Place object first, then proof rows and one action; avoid long multi-column content.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for operational tools that need many visible controls at once.

styles.name: Tech Minimal
styles.brief: Large whitespace, few colors, one visual focus, modern sans-serif type, and a quiet interface.
styles.zhBrief: 大面积空白、少色、单一视觉焦点、现代非衬线字体、界面极简。
styles.bestFor: print studios, editorial tools, focused utility pages
styles.zhBestFor: 印刷工作室、编辑工具、聚焦型实用页面
notes: Use one strong hero object or product surface.
Keep secondary UI quiet and highly aligned.
Prefer black, white, slate, and one measured blue accent.

scenario.headline: Track a small edition from paper stock to pickup shelf.
scenario.lede: A minimal production page for risograph editions, poster runs, ink mixes, proof approvals, and studio pickup windows.
features: Ledger focus
A single production sheet anchors the page instead of a generic SaaS hero.
Studio precision
Paper, ink, drying time, and pickup status read like a real workshop record.
Quiet hierarchy
Whitespace is used to separate job stages, not to make the page feel empty.

launch: Proof approval
Arrange the main object, decision path, and supporting details before polishing the style.
metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.
assets: Paper and ink details
Use visual objects that belong to the scene so the sample feels lived-in and useful.

playbook.name: Minimal Print Ledger
playbook.structure: Sparse production sheet with print job header, paper and ink ledger, proof panel, pickup rail, and clean decision controls.
playbook.zhStructure: 稀疏生产单布局，包含印刷任务头、纸张与油墨账页、校样面板、取件轨和干净决策控件。
playbook.typography: Use small labels, tabular quantities, quiet headings, and precise production notes.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用小标签、表格数字、安静标题和精确生产说明。
playbook.components: Job rows, ink passes, proof approval, drying status, and pickup windows should feel like studio paperwork.
playbook.zhComponents: 任务行、油墨版次、校样审批、干燥状态和取件窗口要像工作室单据。
playbook.buttons: Buttons are minimal rectangles or text actions with high alignment.
playbook.zhButtons: 按钮为极简矩形或文字操作，保持高度对齐。
playbook.media: Use paper stocks, ink passes, proof crops, and docket rows instead of code snippets.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用纸张、油墨版次、校样裁切和任务单行，不使用代码片段。
playbook.states: Show drying, approved, pickup due, low stock, selected proof, and printed states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 drying、approved、pickup due、low stock、selected proof 和 printed 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not turn minimalism into a blank page with no production evidence.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要把极简做成缺少生产证据的空白页。

geometry.description: minimal small-radius surfaces with precise controls

implementation.buttons: Use minimal dark primary buttons, quiet secondary actions, clear focus rings, and no decorative button glow.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用极简深色主按钮、安静次按钮、清晰焦点环，不使用装饰性按钮发光。
implementation.feedback: Use plain inline alerts, compact success toasts, and reserved empty states.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用朴素内联提示、紧凑成功 toast 和克制空状态。
implementation.spacing: Use 24-32px page rhythm, 16px component gaps, and narrow text measures around product proof.
implementation.zhSpacing: 页面节奏 24-32px，组件间距 16px，产品证明周围文本宽度克制。
implementation.responsive: Desktop can be sparse; mobile preserves the single focus object and moves secondary controls below it.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可稀疏；手机保留单一焦点对象，并把次级控件下移。

adaptation.landing: Use a focused product brief with one central proof object, concise copy, and quiet secondary links.
adaptation.dashboard: Use clean metrics, simple lists, small charts, and generous whitespace around the main decision.
adaptation.admin: Use orderly forms, tables, and settings pages with minimal decoration and strong alignment.
adaptation.forms: Use simple labels, compact helper text, precise focus rings, and calm error states.
adaptation.mobile: Keep one focus object, primary action, then details; move secondary controls below content.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for brands that need strong personality or dramatic visual storytelling.

styles.name: Dark Theme
styles.brief: Dark background, high contrast, and one bright monochrome accent for primary actions and the main visual.
styles.zhBrief: 暗背景、高对比度，并用单色亮色强化主按钮和主视觉。
styles.bestFor: micro-cinemas, creative studios, premium launch pages
styles.zhBestFor: 微型影院、创意工作室、高级发布页
notes: Reserve the bright accent for conversion and focus.
Use deep blacks with subtle panel separation.
Keep imagery cinematic but readable.

scenario.headline: Stage tonight's screening with reels, seats, and projection notes.
scenario.lede: A dark cultural venue page for independent film nights, director cuts, reserved rows, and projection booth readiness.
features: Frame led layout
The main viewer behaves like a screening window, with reel notes and seat status attached.
Night atmosphere
Dark panels and a single bright action support the cinema mood without hiding details.
Operational culture
Program order, cue sheet, and booth status make the page useful, not only pretty.

launch: Screening setup
Arrange the main object, decision path, and supporting details before polishing the style.
metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.
assets: Film and booth assets
Use visual objects that belong to the scene so the sample feels lived-in and useful.

playbook.name: Dark Cinema Review
playbook.structure: Cinematic venue board with a screening frame, program strip, seat ledger, booth status, and night-mode actions.
playbook.zhStructure: 影院感场馆面板，包含放映画面、节目条、座位账页、放映室状态和夜间操作。
playbook.typography: Use high-contrast dark UI text, restrained labels, and cinematic but readable titles.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用高对比暗色界面文字、克制标签和电影感但可读的标题。
playbook.components: Screen frames, film strips, seat holds, booth notes, and program cards should feel operational.
playbook.zhComponents: 银幕框、胶片条、座位保留、放映室说明和节目卡要有真实运营感。
playbook.buttons: Primary action is bright and focused; secondary actions use dark outlines.
playbook.zhButtons: 主操作明亮聚焦，次操作使用暗色描边。
playbook.media: Use reels, frame crops, reserved rows, cue sheets, and booth readiness notes.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用胶片、画面裁切、保留排、提示单和放映室准备说明。
playbook.states: Show queued, held, ready, late doors, sold out, and booth warning states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 queued、held、ready、late doors、sold out 和 booth warning 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not use dark cards without a media or venue structure.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要使用缺少媒体或场馆结构的通用暗色卡片。

geometry.description: cinematic dark surfaces with compact angular controls

implementation.buttons: Use high-contrast dark buttons, cinematic hover states, and loading states that feel like render progress.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用高对比暗色按钮、电影感 hover，以及像渲染进度的加载态。
implementation.feedback: Use dark toasts, cost warnings, render-complete confirmations, and visible retry actions.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用暗色 toast、成本警告、渲染完成确认和可见重试操作。
implementation.spacing: Use 20-28px panels, 14px media gaps, and clear separation between viewer and queue.
implementation.zhSpacing: 面板内边距 20-28px，媒体间距 14px，查看器和队列清楚分隔。
implementation.responsive: Desktop keeps viewer and queue split; mobile shows viewer, primary render action, then queue and budget details.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面拆分查看器和队列；手机先查看器，再主渲染操作，之后队列和预算。

adaptation.landing: Use a cinematic viewer, render proof, budget/status warnings, and one bright primary action.
adaptation.dashboard: Use render queues, review states, media thumbnails, failure badges, and retry actions.
adaptation.admin: Use dark production controls, batch review tables, and visible cost/error states.
adaptation.forms: Use dark fields, high-contrast labels, stable loading buttons, and retry-focused errors.
adaptation.mobile: Show viewer, primary action, queue, then budget and errors; avoid hiding retry actions.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for text-heavy documentation or low-contrast casual reading.

styles.name: Structured Lines
styles.brief: Fine line frames, structured rhythm, professional seriousness, and clear information hierarchy.
styles.zhBrief: 细线框、结构化、专业严肃、信息层级清晰。
styles.bestFor: museum maps, workflow products, structured B2B sites
styles.zhBestFor: 博物馆地图、工作流产品、结构化 B2B 网站
notes: Let borders organize information before shadows do.
Use diagrams, rails, and labeled groups.
Keep the tone factual and composed.

scenario.headline: Map a gallery walk from entrance wall to final listening bench.
scenario.lede: A structured museum page for exhibition routes, artwork labels, accessibility stops, docent timing, and visitor flow.
features: Linework navigation
Routes, wall numbers, and object labels are drawn as a plan rather than as loose cards.
Public clarity
The page keeps entrance, accessible path, rest points, and labels legible.
Curatorial rhythm
Each stop has a purpose: look, listen, rest, or read.

launch: Route planning
Arrange the main object, decision path, and supporting details before polishing the style.
metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.
assets: Labels and floor plan

playbook.name: Line Museum Plan
playbook.structure: Floor-plan layout with route lines, numbered exhibition stops, labels, guide notes, and accessibility callouts.
playbook.zhStructure: 平面图布局，包含路线线条、编号展点、标签、导览说明和无障碍标注。
playbook.typography: Use factual captions, exact numbering, map labels, and compact guide copy.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用事实型图注、精确编号、地图标签和紧凑导览文案。
playbook.components: Route nodes, wall labels, stop cards, rest points, and export controls should rely on lines before shadows.
playbook.zhComponents: 路线节点、墙面标签、展点卡、休息点和导出控件应优先依赖线条而非阴影。
playbook.buttons: Use disciplined rectangular controls aligned to the plan grid.
playbook.zhButtons: 使用克制矩形控件，并对齐平面图网格。
playbook.media: Use gallery maps, object labels, accessibility routes, and docent timing notes.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用展厅地图、作品标签、无障碍路线和导览时间说明。
playbook.states: Show current stop, quiet seat, label proof, route open, blocked path, and exported states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 current stop、quiet seat、label proof、route open、blocked path 和 exported 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not replace the plan with decorative cards.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要用装饰卡片替代平面图。

geometry.description: linework structure with almost-square components

implementation.buttons: Use line-based buttons, compact action labels, and focus states that strengthen the rule system.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用线性按钮、紧凑动作标签，以及增强规则线系统的焦点态。
implementation.feedback: Use rule-separated banners, inline audit notes, and visible state chips without soft shadows.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用规则线分隔 banner、内联审计说明和可见状态 chip，不用柔阴影。
implementation.spacing: Use 20-24px grid gutters, 1px dividers, 12px evidence rows, and strict alignment.
implementation.zhSpacing: 网格间距 20-24px，1px 分割线，证据行 12px，严格对齐。
implementation.responsive: Desktop uses process lanes; mobile turns lanes into ordered cards with the current step and action visible.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面使用流程泳道；手机把泳道变成有序卡片，并显示当前步骤和操作。

adaptation.landing: Use a structured process map, evidence panels, and precise conversion actions.
adaptation.dashboard: Use workflow lanes, tables, audit evidence, status chips, and rule-based grouping.
adaptation.admin: Use B2B forms, approval tables, permissions, and line-separated validation.
adaptation.forms: Use strict alignment, visible labels, compact errors, and clear section dividers.
adaptation.mobile: Turn lanes into ordered cards with current step and action visible before evidence.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for playful campaigns or pages that need emotional softness.

styles.name: Layered Material
styles.brief: Clear elevation, large tonal cards, generous radius, and orderly touch-friendly surfaces.
styles.zhBrief: 层次分明、大色块卡片、大圆角、有秩序且适合触控的表面。
styles.bestFor: interior sample boards, consumer tools, product dashboards
styles.zhBestFor: 室内样板板、消费者工具、产品仪表盘
notes: Use large touch-friendly controls.
Separate hierarchy with tonal surfaces.
Keep motion and states calm and systematic.

scenario.headline: Compare wood, textile, stone, and paint before the room is built.
scenario.lede: A tactile interior design page for sample boards, finish palettes, supplier notes, room mood, and approval decisions.
features: Sample stack
Physical layers, swatches, and supplier labels replace abstract product cards.
Room logic
Each material is tied to a real placement such as wall, floor, counter, or textile.
Approval trail
Availability, finish note, and owner decision remain visible together.

launch: Board approval
Arrange the main object, decision path, and supporting details before polishing the style.
metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.
assets: Material samples
Use visual objects that belong to the scene so the sample feels lived-in and useful.

playbook.name: Layered Interior Samples
playbook.structure: Material-board layout with stacked samples, swatch lanes, room placement notes, supplier rows, and approval rail.
playbook.zhStructure: 材料板布局，包含叠放样品、色片轨、空间位置说明、供应商行和审批轨。
playbook.typography: Use friendly material labels, room placement captions, and clear stock values.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用友好材质标签、空间位置图注和清晰库存数值。
playbook.components: Swatches, sample stacks, supplier chips, placement notes, and approval states should share tactile depth.
playbook.zhComponents: 色片、样品叠层、供应商标签、位置说明和审批状态要共享触感层级。
playbook.buttons: Use touch-friendly tonal buttons with visible selected states.
playbook.zhButtons: 使用适合触控的调性按钮，并有可见选中态。
playbook.media: Use wood, textile, stone, paint, room plans, and supplier labels as content.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用木、织物、石材、涂料、房间图和供应商标签作为内容。
playbook.states: Show chosen, hold, sample due, low stock, approved, and compare states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 chosen、hold、sample due、low stock、approved 和 compare 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not make layered material look like a generic task dashboard.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要把层级材质做成通用任务仪表盘。

geometry.description: material-friendly curves reserved for touch surfaces

implementation.buttons: Use touch-friendly filled and tonal buttons, clear selected states, and disabled states that preserve material depth.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用适合触控的实色和调性按钮、清楚选中态，以及保留材质深度的禁用态。
implementation.feedback: Use calm snackbars, inline helper text, and clear routine-complete confirmations.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用平静 snackbar、内联帮助文本和清晰日程完成确认。
implementation.spacing: Use 24px touch panels, 12-16px list gaps, and comfortable 44-52px controls.
implementation.zhSpacing: 触控面板 24px，列表间距 12-16px，控件高度 44-52px。
implementation.responsive: Desktop can show phone panel and cloud; mobile keeps the daily panel first and converts side content into stacked cards.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可展示手机面板和信息云；手机先日程面板，侧内容变为堆叠卡片。

adaptation.landing: Use layered product surfaces, touch-friendly proof cards, and calm utility storytelling.
adaptation.dashboard: Use large touch panels, routine cards, tonal status surfaces, and comfortable controls.
adaptation.admin: Use settings, forms, and utility dashboards where clarity and touch targets matter.
adaptation.forms: Use filled and tonal inputs, clear helper text, calm snackbars, and large touch targets.
adaptation.mobile: Put the daily or utility panel first; convert side content into stacked cards.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for hard-edged technical consoles or editorial layouts that need strict rules.

styles.name: Bento Layout
styles.brief: Widget-like card zones, modular composition, and clearly chunked information.
styles.zhBrief: 小组件式卡片分区、模块化排布、信息清晰分块。
styles.bestFor: restaurant menus, creator profiles, modular product overviews
styles.zhBestFor: 餐厅菜单、创作者主页、模块化产品总览
notes: Use varied card sizes with one consistent grid.
Each block should have a clear job.
Avoid turning every block into identical cards.

scenario.headline: Build a dinner story from market crates, chef notes, and table timing.
scenario.lede: A bento-style restaurant page for seasonal courses, local producers, table counts, chef quotes, and service rhythm.
features: Food blocks
Large and small tiles follow actual service meaning: hero course, producer note, quote, timing, and booking.
Market texture
Ingredient blocks carry the visual energy instead of decorative shapes.
Uneven but useful
The grid changes size by content value, not randomly.

launch: Service story
Arrange the main object, decision path, and supporting details before polishing the style.
metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.
assets: Menu and market objects
Use visual objects that belong to the scene so the sample feels lived-in and useful.

playbook.name: Bento Market Table
playbook.structure: Irregular food-service bento with hero course, producer notes, market run, table status, chef quote, and booking block.
playbook.zhStructure: 不等格餐饮便当布局，包含主菜、生产者说明、采购行程、桌位状态、主厨引用和预订块。
playbook.typography: Use compact tile labels, warm menu headings, and clear local hierarchy in each block.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用紧凑块标签、温暖菜单标题，并在每个块内建立清晰局部层级。
playbook.components: Course tiles, market crates, table chips, chef notes, and service timing blocks should vary by content value.
playbook.zhComponents: 菜品块、市集箱、桌位标签、主厨笔记和服务时间块应按内容价值变化。
playbook.buttons: Use embedded tile actions and one confident reservation control.
playbook.zhButtons: 使用块内操作和一个明确预订控件。
playbook.media: Use ingredient blocks, menu notes, market labels, and service timing as the visual language.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用食材块、菜单说明、市集标签和服务时间作为视觉语言。
playbook.states: Show lead course, open table, market pickup, sold out, prepping, and saved states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 lead course、open table、market pickup、sold out、prepping 和 saved 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not make every bento tile the same size.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要把每个便当块做成同尺寸。

geometry.description: modular bento curves without making every item identical

implementation.buttons: Use compact buttons embedded only where a tile has a job; selected tiles need obvious but not loud treatment.
implementation.zhButtons: 只在有明确任务的模块内嵌紧凑按钮；选中模块要明显但不吵。
implementation.feedback: Use tile-local badges, progress chips, and empty tile states with next actions.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用模块内徽章、进度 chip，以及带下一步的空模块状态。
implementation.spacing: Use 16px grid gaps, varied tile padding, and stable aspect ratios for visual rhythm.
implementation.zhSpacing: 网格间距 16px，模块内边距可变化，使用稳定宽高比形成节奏。
implementation.responsive: Desktop can use varied tile spans; mobile becomes one column while preserving tile order by importance.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可使用不同跨度模块；手机变成单列，并按重要性保持模块顺序。

adaptation.landing: Use uneven tiles where each block has a job: proof, media, quote, stat, timeline, and action.
adaptation.dashboard: Use modular status tiles, varied spans, local actions, and progress badges.
adaptation.admin: Use admin only when modules are independent; avoid forcing dense tables into bento tiles.
adaptation.forms: Use forms inside purposeful tiles with local validation and stable tile dimensions.
adaptation.mobile: Collapse to one column while preserving tile order by importance.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for long tables, legal documents, or workflows needing strict linear review.

styles.name: Neumorphism
styles.brief: Soft light, inset depth, rounded controls, and gentle shadows with tactile surfaces.
styles.zhBrief: 柔光、内凹层次感圆角、柔和阴影和触感表面。
styles.bestFor: home devices, audio tools, calm utilities, wellness and focus products
styles.zhBestFor: 家居设备、音频工具、安静工具、健康与专注类产品
notes: Keep contrast high enough despite the soft surface.
Use inset states for pressed controls.
Limit the style to focused, calm interfaces.

scenario.headline: Tune the evening shelf with soft light, music, and one calm timer.
scenario.lede: A neumorphic control page for a home mood lamp, bedside audio, reading timer, and gentle scene presets.
features: Physical controls
Raised pads, inset wells, and a central dial make the page feel like a real object.
Home scale
The interface focuses on a shelf, a lamp, and an evening routine rather than a dense dashboard.
Soft states
Pressed, saved, dimmed, and timer states stay readable despite the gentle surface.

launch: Scene control
Arrange the main object, decision path, and supporting details before polishing the style.
metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.
assets: Lamp and audio controls
Use visual objects that belong to the scene so the sample feels lived-in and useful.

playbook.name: Neumo Lamp Console
playbook.structure: Tactile home console with raised lamp dial, inset timer, scene pads, audio strip, and saved evening routines.
playbook.zhStructure: 触感家庭控制台，包含凸起灯光旋钮、内凹计时器、场景按钮、音频条和已保存夜间流程。
playbook.typography: Use calm labels, large readable values, and limited headings for relaxed operation.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用平静标签、大号可读数值和有限标题，适合放松操作。
playbook.components: Dials, pads, inset meters, scene rows, and timer controls should feel physical and focused.
playbook.zhComponents: 旋钮、按钮垫、内凹仪表、场景行和计时控件要有实体触感且聚焦。
playbook.buttons: Use raised and pressed states with enough contrast for tactile controls.
playbook.zhButtons: 使用凸起和按下态，并确保触感控件有足够对比。
playbook.media: Use lamp glow, shelf surfaces, audio waves, and timer wells instead of finance widgets.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用灯光、置物架、音频波形和计时槽，不使用金融组件。
playbook.states: Show active, saved, dimmed, timer running, muted, and pressed states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 active、saved、dimmed、timer running、muted 和 pressed 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not let soft shadows hide state or reduce readability.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要让柔阴影隐藏状态或降低可读性。

geometry.description: soft tactile curves for raised and inset controls

implementation.buttons: Use raised and inset tactile buttons, pressed states that sink inward, and loading states that keep the soft surface stable.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用凸起和内凹触感按钮，按下态向内沉，加载态保持柔和表面稳定。
implementation.feedback: Use gentle inset alerts, saved-preset confirmations, and calm validation messages.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用柔和内凹提示、预设保存确认和平静校验消息。
implementation.spacing: Use 22-30px soft panels, 14-18px mixer gaps, and large tap targets.
implementation.zhSpacing: 柔和面板内边距 22-30px，混音器间距 14-18px，点击目标要大。
implementation.responsive: Desktop can use multiple tactile columns; mobile stacks controls and keeps the active preset near the primary action.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可使用多列触感控件；手机堆叠控件，并让当前预设靠近主操作。

adaptation.landing: Use tactile controls, session state, presets, and soft proof for calm utility products.
adaptation.dashboard: Use knobs, sliders, preset pads, active layers, and session meters rather than card grids.
adaptation.admin: Use sparingly for small settings tools; keep contrast and state clarity higher than the soft surface.
adaptation.forms: Use inset fields, raised buttons, calm validation, and large tap targets.
adaptation.mobile: Stack controls, keep active preset near the primary action, and avoid dense tables.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for dense admin systems, long documents, or high-alert operational products.

styles.name: Liquid Glass
styles.brief: Frosted glass, transparent layering, blurred materials, and a futuristic technology mood.
styles.zhBrief: 毛玻璃、透明层次、磨砂质感、科技感和未来感。
styles.bestFor: botanical maps, spatial dashboards, premium futuristic tools
styles.zhBestFor: 植物园地图、空间化仪表盘、高级未来感工具
notes: Layer translucent panels over vivid but softened media.
Use blur, tint, and borders to keep text readable.
Avoid low-contrast glass over busy images.

scenario.headline: Float humidity, watering, and visitor paths over a living conservatory.
scenario.lede: A liquid glass page for plant houses, climate rooms, watering routes, glass roofs, and public garden visits.
features: Living map
Glass layers sit over beds, paths, and climate zones instead of a generic sci-fi background.
Readable translucency
Tint and borders protect text while still feeling like glass.
Garden operations
Visitor route, water schedule, and climate status are visible at once.

launch: Canopy map
Arrange the main object, decision path, and supporting details before polishing the style.
metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.
assets: Plants and glass layers
Use visual objects that belong to the scene so the sample feels lived-in and useful.

playbook.name: Glasshouse Climate Map
playbook.structure: Translucent conservatory map with climate panes, water zones, canopy paths, plant notes, and visitor route controls.
playbook.zhStructure: 透明温室地图，包含气候面板、水区、冠层路径、植物说明和参观路线控件。
playbook.typography: Use clean futuristic labels with high contrast over every glass layer.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用干净未来感标签，并保证每层玻璃上的高对比。
playbook.components: Glass panels, climate pins, watering rows, plant cards, and route overlays should stay readable.
playbook.zhComponents: 玻璃面板、气候针点、浇水行、植物卡和路线覆盖层都要保持可读。
playbook.buttons: Use bordered glass controls and bright active states that do not rely on blur alone.
playbook.zhButtons: 使用带边框玻璃控件和不只依赖模糊的明亮激活态。
playbook.media: Use plant beds, canopy maps, mist zones, roof lines, and watering schedules.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用植物床、冠层地图、雾化区域、屋顶线和浇水计划。
playbook.states: Show stable, due, open path, climate drift, selected zone, and mist running states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 stable、due、open path、climate drift、selected zone 和 mist running 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not put low-contrast text over busy translucent scenery.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要把低对比文字放在复杂透明场景上。

geometry.description: glass curves balanced by visible structure

implementation.buttons: Use glass buttons with visible borders, readable labels, and hover states based on tint rather than blur alone.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用带可见边框的玻璃按钮、可读标签，以及基于色调而不是只靠模糊的 hover。
implementation.feedback: Use translucent toasts, map-layer alerts, and readable inline status cards over glass.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用半透明 toast、地图层提示，以及玻璃上可读的内联状态卡。
implementation.spacing: Use 20-28px glass panels, 14px translucent gaps, and stable backdrops under text.
implementation.zhSpacing: 玻璃面板 20-28px，透明层间距 14px，文本下方背景稳定。
implementation.responsive: Desktop can split map and controls; mobile places controls above the map when the action matters more than ambience.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可拆分地图和控件；手机在操作更重要时把控件放到地图前。

adaptation.landing: Use a glass map or spatial product story with readable translucent panels and stable media backdrops.
adaptation.dashboard: Use signal layers, selected rooms, map pins, translucent controls, and readable alerts.
adaptation.admin: Use for premium spatial tools, not conventional back-office CRUD unless the map/object is central.
adaptation.forms: Use glass fields only over stable surfaces; focus and errors need visible borders and text.
adaptation.mobile: Place controls above ambience when action matters; keep glass panels readable over every background.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for low-power devices, accessibility-critical dense forms, or plain official portals.

styles.name: Retro Computing
styles.brief: Pixel mood, old operating-system texture, 80s computing cues, chunky windows, and bitmap type.
styles.zhBrief: 像素风、复古 UI、老式操作系统质感、80 年代计算机线索、块状窗口和像素字体。
styles.bestFor: music sites, game-adjacent products, cultural campaigns
styles.zhBestFor: 音乐网站、游戏相关产品、文化活动页
notes: Use hard windows, pixel dividers, and playful system chrome.
Keep nostalgia intentional, not broken.
Use bright accents with crisp black lines.

scenario.headline: Run the release from a chunky desktop board.
scenario.lede: A pixel-flavored campaign page for music, game-adjacent products, zines, and nostalgic creative tools.
features: Old system texture
Chunky windows, hard pixels, and bitmap rhythm create nostalgia with intent.
Functional chrome
Window bars, tabs, and file rows are real UI, not only decoration.
Bright precision
Crisp lines keep the playful palette from becoming messy.

launch: Release board
Arrange files, player controls, notes, and launch tasks like a retro workstation.
metrics: Track plays, saves, file opens, and newsletter joins.
assets: Desktop objects
Use windows, folder chips, mini players, and pixel dividers as core content.

playbook.name: Retro Desktop Workspace
playbook.structure: Old desktop environment with overlapping windows, title bars, pixel panels, and file-like action rows.
playbook.zhStructure: 老式桌面环境，包含重叠窗口、标题栏、像素面板和文件式操作行。
playbook.typography: Use monospace or bitmap-like rhythm, crisp labels, and short window titles.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用等宽或像素节奏、清晰标签和短窗口标题。
playbook.components: Windows, title bars, folder rows, mini players, file chips, and pixel dividers should feel functional.
playbook.zhComponents: 窗口、标题栏、文件夹行、迷你播放器、文件标签和像素分割线要有功能感。
playbook.buttons: Buttons are rectangular system controls with hard borders and pressed offsets.
playbook.zhButtons: 按钮是矩形系统控件，带硬边框和按下偏移。
playbook.media: Use file windows, player bars, pixel diagrams, and desktop objects as the visual language.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用文件窗口、播放器条、像素图和桌面对象作为视觉语言。
playbook.states: Show open, saved, playing, minimized, selected file, and modal states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 open、saved、playing、minimized、selected file 和 modal 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not make the page look broken; nostalgia still needs clear UI.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要让页面看起来像坏掉；怀旧仍然需要清晰界面。

geometry.description: retro system windows with hard pixel edges

implementation.buttons: Use OS-window buttons, sharp pixel borders, hard active states, and disabled controls that look unavailable in-system.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用操作系统窗口按钮、锐利像素边框、硬按下态，以及系统内不可用的禁用控件。
implementation.feedback: Use window-style alerts, file-status rows, and modal dialogs that feel like old desktop chrome.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用窗口式提示、文件状态行，以及像旧桌面 chrome 的弹窗。
implementation.spacing: Use 8-14px window chrome spacing, dense file rows, and clear title bars.
implementation.zhSpacing: 窗口 chrome 间距 8-14px，文件行紧凑，标题栏清楚。
implementation.responsive: Desktop can overlap windows; mobile disables overlap and turns windows into stacked panels.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可重叠窗口；手机取消重叠，窗口变成堆叠面板。

adaptation.landing: Use retro windows, title bars, file lists, and a playful install/play action.
adaptation.dashboard: Use overlapping desktop windows for music, files, queues, and system-style status.
adaptation.admin: Use only for themed tools; make file states, dialogs, and buttons feel intentionally old-system.
adaptation.forms: Use title-bar groups, pixel borders, system alerts, and sharp validation states.
adaptation.mobile: Disable window overlap and turn windows into stacked panels with clear title bars.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for serious finance, healthcare, or modern premium SaaS.

styles.name: Neo-Brutalism
styles.brief: Thick lines, strong color clashes, unpolished giant type, and controlled chaos.
styles.zhBrief: 粗线条、强烈撞色、无修饰巨型字体，混乱但有张力。
styles.bestFor: developer launches, bold campaigns, playful product sites
styles.zhBestFor: 开发者发布页、强品牌活动、趣味产品站
notes: Make the hierarchy loud and unmistakable.
Use strong geometry and intentionally hard shadows.
Preserve usability under the visual tension.

scenario.headline: Ship a louder tool without sanding off the edges.
scenario.lede: A high-collision launch surface for developer products, bold utilities, and campaigns that need directness.
features: Controlled collision
Thick lines, loud blocks, and giant type create force while keeping actions obvious.
Proof over polish
Benchmarks, changelog, and install commands carry the story.
Hard feedback
Errors, warnings, and selected states are unapologetically visible.

launch: Build proof
Show install command, changelog, benchmark, and open issues as the launch story.
metrics: Track installs, stars, issue closures, and build failures.
assets: Proof objects
Use code blocks, stamps, badges, and large labels as functional pieces.

playbook.name: Brutal Proof Release
playbook.structure: Release page built from giant type, proof slabs, install commands, issue strips, and collision blocks.
playbook.zhStructure: 由巨大字体、证明块、安装命令、issue 条和碰撞块构成的发布页。
playbook.typography: Use oversized blunt headings, compact proof labels, and high-contrast code or numbers.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用超大直接标题、紧凑证明标签和高对比代码/数字。
playbook.components: Install commands, benchmarks, issue cards, badges, changelog strips, and alerts carry the story.
playbook.zhComponents: 安装命令、基准、issue 卡、徽章、更新条和警告承载叙事。
playbook.buttons: Buttons are hard, loud, border-heavy, and visibly interactive.
playbook.zhButtons: 按钮硬朗、响亮、重边框，并且明显可交互。
playbook.media: Use code blocks, stamps, benchmark charts, and launch proof instead of decorative art.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用代码块、印章、基准图和发布证明，不使用装饰图。
playbook.states: Show copied, failing, benchmark live, issue closed, warning, and shipped states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 copied、failing、benchmark live、issue closed、warning 和 shipped 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not sand off the energy with soft shadows or polite muted cards.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要用柔和阴影或礼貌灰卡磨平这个风格。

geometry.description: brutalist square geometry and blunt controls

implementation.buttons: Use square high-impact buttons, thick borders, blunt hover shifts, and unmistakable disabled/error blocks.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用方形高冲击按钮、粗边框、直接的 hover 位移，以及非常明确的禁用/错误块。
implementation.feedback: Use loud but structured alert slabs, command confirmations, and status rows with strong contrast.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用响亮但有结构的提示块、命令确认，以及强对比状态行。
implementation.spacing: Use 18-30px collision gaps, oversized slabs, and intentionally uneven but readable groups.
implementation.zhSpacing: 使用 18-30px 碰撞式间距、大块面板，以及不均衡但可读的分组。
implementation.responsive: Desktop can collide panels; mobile removes rotation and turns slabs into a single readable sequence.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可让面板碰撞；手机取消旋转，块面变成单一可读序列。

adaptation.landing: Use collision panels, giant type, command proof, and high-impact install or launch actions.
adaptation.dashboard: Use brutal status walls, issue queues, benchmark slabs, and unmistakable warnings.
adaptation.admin: Use for bold developer/internal tools; keep forms blocky, explicit, and lower density.
adaptation.forms: Use square controls, thick borders, direct labels, and loud but structured errors.
adaptation.mobile: Remove rotation/collision, stack slabs, and keep controls large and readable.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for quiet trust, long reading, or restrained enterprise procurement.

styles.name: Precision Futurism
styles.brief: Dark background, glowing borders, futuristic technology polish, and sci-fi UI precision.
styles.zhBrief: 深色背景、发光边框、未来科技感和科幻 UI 精度。
styles.bestFor: issue trackers, AI operations tools, technical SaaS
styles.zhBestFor: Issue 工具、AI 运营工具、技术型 SaaS
notes: Keep the surface quiet and precise.
Use glow as a state signal, not decoration everywhere.
Favor clean lists, compact cards, and command-like actions.

scenario.headline: Pin every failing span on one technical operations map.
scenario.lede: A full-width command console for incident tracing, service topology, span replay, and latency evidence.
features: Map-first layout
The topology field takes the main space while side data stays attached to active nodes.
Compact evidence
Trace rows, span IDs, retry state, and command actions stay dense and deliberate.
Controlled glow
Light is reserved for selected paths, errors, and replay-ready states.

launch: Incident map
Trace active paths, compare retries, and inspect failing spans without leaving the console.
metrics: Track latency, retry count, incident age, and mean recovery time.
assets: Trace evidence
Use graph nodes, span rows, logs, and timeline fragments as the visual system.

playbook.name: Precision Incident Map
playbook.structure: Full-width technical map with topology canvas, span lanes, replay command bar, incident ticker, and attached evidence panels.
playbook.zhStructure: 全宽技术地图，包含拓扑画布、span 泳道、回放命令栏、事故滚动条和附着证据面板。
playbook.typography: Use compact technical UI type, precise labels, and aligned numeric values.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用紧凑技术界面字体、精确标签和对齐数值。
playbook.components: Topology nodes, span lanes, incident chips, command buttons, latency strips, and replay fragments should feel engineered.
playbook.zhComponents: 拓扑节点、span 泳道、事件标签、命令按钮、延迟条和回放片段要有工程感。
playbook.buttons: Buttons are compact dark controls with glow reserved for active or critical actions.
playbook.zhButtons: 按钮是紧凑暗色控件，发光只用于激活或关键操作。
playbook.media: Use topology maps, traces, logs, span diagrams, and evidence overlays instead of generic sci-fi backgrounds.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用拓扑地图、追踪、日志、span 图和证据覆盖层，不用通用科幻背景。
playbook.states: Show active path, fail, retry, replay ready, incident open, and selected node states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 active path、fail、retry、replay ready、incident open 和 selected node 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not cover precise information with excessive glow.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要用过量发光遮住精确信息。

geometry.description: precision console geometry with low-radius panels

implementation.buttons: Use precise command buttons, thin glow only on active/focus states, and compact disabled states for technical control.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用精密命令按钮，只在 active/focus 使用细发光，并为技术控件提供紧凑禁用态。
implementation.feedback: Use trace toasts, incident chips, warning rows, and replay confirmations tied to real system state.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用 trace toast、incident chip、警告行，以及绑定真实系统状态的 replay 确认。
implementation.spacing: Use 16-20px console panels, 8-12px trace rows, and dense tabular metrics.
implementation.zhSpacing: 控制台面板 16-20px，trace 行 8-12px，指标紧凑且表格数字对齐。
implementation.responsive: Desktop keeps graph, trace panel, and queue; mobile shows trace summary, then graph, then queue.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面保留图、trace 面板和队列；手机先 trace 摘要，再图，再队列。

adaptation.landing: Use a precise technical product story with graph, traces, incidents, and command action.
adaptation.dashboard: Use graph console, trace list, compact metrics, incident chips, and replay controls.
adaptation.admin: Use for technical SaaS operations, issue triage, observability, and workflow replay.
adaptation.forms: Use compact dark inputs, command buttons, exact validation, and visible focused edges.
adaptation.mobile: Show trace summary, graph, queue, and replay action in that order.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for soft consumer brands or pages needing warmth over precision.

styles.name: Gradient Pop
styles.brief: Bright gradients, tech or trend energy, and an immediately eye-catching first viewport.
styles.zhBrief: 亮色渐变、科技或潮流气质，首屏视觉抓眼。
styles.bestFor: festival pages, launch walls, creator campaign tools
styles.zhBestFor: 节日活动页、发布墙、创作者活动工具
notes: Use a gradient hero with calmer supporting surfaces.
Let color communicate energy and momentum.
Prevent gradients from overpowering text.

scenario.lede: A vivid page for neighborhood music nights, poster approvals, food stalls, stage timing, and volunteer check-ins.
features: Poster energy
Gradient color becomes a print wall, lineup ribbon, and stage schedule.
Full canvas
The page is packed with usable festival objects so no side feels empty.
Public action
Publish, lineup, and volunteer states remain clearer than the color field.

playbook.name: Gradient Festival Wall
playbook.structure: Bright public-event board with poster wall, lineup ribbon, volunteer rail, stage map, and print-ready actions.
playbook.zhStructure: 明亮公共活动面板，包含海报墙、阵容带、志愿者轨、舞台地图和可印刷操作。
playbook.typography: Use energetic headings, clear public labels, and readable schedule copy.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用有能量标题、清晰公共标签和可读日程文案。
playbook.components: Poster tiles, artist slots, food-lane blocks, volunteer states, and publish gates should fill the canvas.
playbook.zhComponents: 海报块、艺人位、餐饮巷块、志愿者状态和发布闸口要填满画面。
playbook.buttons: Use confident color for the public action and calmer secondary controls.
playbook.zhButtons: 公共操作使用自信色彩，次操作保持安静。
playbook.media: Use posters, lineup cards, stage strips, volunteer tags, and print sizes.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用海报、阵容卡、舞台条、志愿者标签和印刷尺寸。
playbook.states: Show approved, mapped, needs lead, live, printed, and delayed states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 approved、mapped、needs lead、live、printed 和 delayed 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not let gradients overpower schedule readability.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要让渐变压过日程可读性。

geometry.description: energetic gradient surfaces with controlled curves

implementation.buttons: Use confident gradient or solid buttons, restrained secondary buttons, and progress/loading states that feel like a builder flow.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用自信的渐变或实色按钮、克制次按钮，以及像构建流程的进度/加载态。
implementation.feedback: Use bright publish toasts, checklist warnings, and inline success cards near the stepper.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用明亮发布 toast、清单警告，以及靠近 stepper 的内联成功卡。
implementation.spacing: Use 20-28px builder panels, 12-16px template gaps, and clear separation between canvas and checklist.
implementation.zhSpacing: 构建器面板 20-28px，模板间距 12-16px，画布和清单分隔清楚。
implementation.responsive: Desktop can show copy, canvas, and checklist; mobile orders them as headline, primary action, canvas, checklist.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可显示文案、画布和清单；手机顺序为标题、主操作、画布、清单。

adaptation.landing: Use a bright builder narrative with live canvas, stepper, checklist, and publish action.
adaptation.dashboard: Use activation metrics, template states, progress cards, and publish readiness checks.
adaptation.admin: Use for creator/admin builders, content setup, template management, and launch checklists.
adaptation.forms: Use colorful but restrained inputs, progress validation, checklist warnings, and success cards.
adaptation.mobile: Order as headline, primary action, canvas, checklist, then supporting proof.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for restrained legal, formal docs, or very dense reporting dashboards.

styles.name: Soft Pop
styles.brief: Friendly playful color, doodle or cartoon illustration, rounded expressive type, and elastic shapes.
styles.zhBrief: 亲和力和玩乐色彩、手绘涂鸦/卡通插画、圆润夸张字体和带弹性的造型。
styles.bestFor: community classes, education, writing tools, creative productivity
styles.zhBestFor: 社区课堂、教育、写作工具、创意生产力
notes: Round the typography and interaction shapes.
Pair friendly copy with lively but readable components.
Use illustration sparingly as a human signal.

scenario.headline: Plan a weekend workshop around soil, seedlings, and shared notes.
scenario.lede: A soft pop page for community gardens, family classes, seed swaps, lesson cards, and cheerful practice prompts.
features: Gentle learning
Workshop steps, garden objects, and notes create structure without feeling like school software.
Warm utility
The design stays friendly while still showing time, capacity, and next action.
Shared notes
Seed care, class progress, and retry prompts belong to the same garden board.

launch: Workshop plan
Arrange the main object, decision path, and supporting details before polishing the style.
metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.
