playbook.name: Soft Garden Class
playbook.structure: Friendly workshop board with garden plan, lesson card, seed notes, progress path, and cheerful class controls.
playbook.zhStructure: 友好工作坊面板，包含花园计划、课程卡、种子笔记、进度路径和明快课堂控件。
playbook.typography: Use rounded readable type with useful, human, non-childish microcopy.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用圆润可读字体和有用、有人的、不幼稚的微文案。
playbook.components: Seed trays, class steps, note cards, progress tokens, and retry prompts should feel warm and practical.
playbook.zhComponents: 种子盘、课堂步骤、笔记卡、进度 token 和重试提示要温暖且实用。
playbook.buttons: Use warm rounded buttons with clear focus, saved, and disabled states.
playbook.zhButtons: 使用温暖圆角按钮，并有清晰焦点、保存和禁用态。
playbook.media: Use garden beds, seed trays, lesson notes, and soft doodle cues.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用花坛、种子盘、课程笔记和柔和涂鸦线索。
playbook.states: Show ready, watered, saved, class full, retry, and completed states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 ready、watered、saved、class full、retry 和 completed 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not make friendly design vague or babyish.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要把友好设计做得模糊或幼稚。

geometry.description: soft friendly curves limited to the learning mood

implementation.buttons: Use warm rounded buttons, gentle hover, kind disabled language, and retry buttons that feel helpful rather than punitive.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用温暖圆角按钮、温和 hover、有善意的禁用文案，以及不惩罚用户的重试按钮。
implementation.feedback: Use encouraging success notes, kind error messages, saved-note toasts, and empty lessons with clear next steps.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用鼓励型成功说明、友好错误文案、保存笔记 toast，以及带下一步的空课程状态。
implementation.spacing: Use 20-28px friendly panels, 12-16px lesson gaps, and comfortable reading line height.
implementation.zhSpacing: 友好面板 20-28px，课程间距 12-16px，阅读行高舒适。
implementation.responsive: Desktop can show path, practice, and notes; mobile shows practice first, then path, then progress notes.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可显示路径、练习和笔记；手机先练习，再路径，再进度笔记。

adaptation.landing: Use friendly learning story, progress path, saved notes, and encouraging primary action.
adaptation.dashboard: Use practice cards, lesson paths, note stacks, streaks, and kind retry states.
adaptation.admin: Use for education/community tools, not dense finance or strict enterprise approvals.
adaptation.forms: Use readable labels, kind errors, saved-note toasts, and comfortable line height.
adaptation.mobile: Show practice first, then path, then notes; keep touch targets generous.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for severe incidents, high-density analytics, or luxury minimal portfolios.

styles.name: Acid Design
styles.brief: Metal sheen, liquid chrome type, distorted composition, laser light, dark sci-fi, and psychedelic tension.
styles.zhBrief: 金属光泽、液态金属字体、铬材质、扭曲排版、镭射光、暗黑科幻和致幻感。
styles.bestFor: experimental portfolios, music/fashion drops, immersive campaigns
styles.zhBestFor: 实验作品集、音乐/时尚发布、沉浸式活动页
notes: Use distortion and chrome as brand moments, not body text.
Keep enough stable UI for orientation.
Let neon accents cut through a dark surreal base.

scenario.headline: Make the page feel like a warped signal.
scenario.lede: A high-intensity visual surface for experimental portfolios, music drops, fashion-adjacent campaigns, and immersive launches.
features: Controlled distortion
Chrome, laser color, and warped type create impact while body text stays readable.
Stable anchors
Navigation, actions, and status chips keep the experience usable inside the chaos.
Rare intensity
The style is strongest when used for brands that can carry risk and attitude.

launch: Signal staging
Place the drop, timer, archive shards, and primary entry point in a distorted composition.
metrics: Track entry clicks, shard opens, timer returns, and archive saves.
assets: Rift objects
Use chrome slabs, laser rules, and cut-up media as content anchors.

playbook.name: Acid Signal Poster
playbook.structure: Asymmetric experimental poster with chrome slabs, laser cuts, warped title treatment, and stable navigation anchors.
playbook.zhStructure: 不对称实验海报，包含铬面块、镭射切线、扭曲标题处理和稳定导航锚点。
playbook.typography: Use distorted display moments only for headlines; keep body copy and controls readable.
playbook.zhTypography: 扭曲展示字只用于标题瞬间；正文和控件保持可读。
playbook.components: Signal shards, timer chips, archive cuts, chrome buttons, and high-contrast anchor controls define the UI.
playbook.zhComponents: 信号碎片、计时标签、档案切片、铬面按钮和高对比锚点控件定义界面。
playbook.buttons: Buttons can be metallic or laser-outlined but must remain obvious actions.
playbook.zhButtons: 按钮可以是金属或镭射描边，但必须显然是操作。
playbook.media: Use chrome slabs, cut-up images, laser rules, and dark surreal fields as content anchors.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用铬面块、切片图像、镭射线和暗黑超现实场作为内容锚点。
playbook.states: Show live drop, hidden shard, tuned title, entered, archived, and expired states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 live drop、hidden shard、tuned title、entered、archived 和 expired 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not apply distortion to small text, forms, or critical controls.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要把扭曲效果用于小字、表单或关键控件。

geometry.description: acid-edged geometry with sharp anchor controls

implementation.buttons: Use sharp chrome or laser-outline buttons, stable labels, and active states that stay readable under visual distortion.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用锐利铬面或镭射描边按钮、稳定标签，以及在视觉扭曲下仍可读的 active 状态。
implementation.feedback: Use high-contrast signal alerts, archive confirmations, and expired-state warnings without distorting body text.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用高对比信号提示、归档确认和过期警告，但不要扭曲正文。
implementation.spacing: Use 18-26px experimental slabs, 10-14px shard gaps, and stable anchor zones for controls.
implementation.zhSpacing: 实验块面 18-26px，碎片间距 10-14px，并为控件保留稳定锚点区域。
implementation.responsive: Desktop may be asymmetric and surreal; mobile removes distortion from controls and stacks title, action, media, and shards.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可不对称且超现实；手机移除控件扭曲，并堆叠标题、操作、媒体和碎片。

adaptation.landing: Use experimental title, chrome media, laser cuts, stable nav anchors, and a readable entry action.
adaptation.dashboard: Use only for expressive live signal or archive surfaces with strong stable control zones.
adaptation.admin: Use sparingly; critical forms and tables must be distortion-free and high contrast.
adaptation.forms: Use sharp fields, clear labels, no text distortion, and high-contrast expired/error states.
adaptation.mobile: Remove distortion from controls and stack title, action, media, and shards.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for accessibility-critical admin, long copy, or conservative institutional products.

styles.name: Art Deco
styles.brief: Symmetric poster composition, dark jewel tones, gilded rules, stepped geometry, and polished hospitality drama.
styles.zhBrief: 对称海报构图、暗色宝石调、金色线框、阶梯几何和精致的高级场景感。
styles.bestFor: luxury hospitality, cultural venues, premium events, editorial brand launches
styles.zhBestFor: 高级酒店、文化场馆、精品活动、编辑型品牌发布
notes: Build the page around symmetry, axial alignment, and staged reveal.
Use gold rules as structure, not random trim.
Keep copy refined and short so the ornament has room to breathe.

scenario.headline: Reserve a velvet table for a brass set and midnight dessert.
scenario.lede: An Art Deco venue page for jazz nights, supper club tables, program cards, bar service, and gold-framed availability.
features: Axial drama
Symmetry, stepped frames, and gold rules feel like a theatre foyer, not a luxury wallpaper.
Reservation proof
Tables, set times, bar notes, and program states become polished labels.
Ceremony with use
The primary action is staged but still immediate.

launch: Table release
Arrange the main object, decision path, and supporting details before polishing the style.
metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.

playbook.name: Deco Theatre Foyer
playbook.structure: Symmetric jazz-theatre booking page with marquee axis, table availability, program cards, bar notes, and gilded seating plan.
playbook.zhStructure: 对称爵士剧场预订页，包含跑马灯轴线、桌位状态、节目卡、酒吧说明和鎏金座位图。
playbook.typography: Use elegant display headings, refined numerals, and short polished venue labels.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用优雅展示标题、精致数字和短而 polished 的场馆标签。
playbook.components: Marquee frames, table rows, set-time labels, program strips, and ceremonial booking controls should align to the center axis.
playbook.zhComponents: 门厅框、桌位行、演出时间标签、节目条和仪式感预订控件应对齐中心轴。
playbook.buttons: Use framed gold primary buttons and fine outline secondary actions.
playbook.zhButtons: 使用金色框线主按钮和细描边次操作。
playbook.media: Use seating plans, stage labels, program cards, velvet textures, and bar menu notes.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用座位图、舞台标签、节目卡、天鹅绒质感和酒吧菜单说明。
playbook.states: Show open, signed, first set, held, waitlist, and invitation states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 open、signed、first set、held、waitlist 和 invitation 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not scatter gold trim without information value.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要撒没有信息价值的金色装饰。

geometry.description: stepped Art Deco geometry with crisp framed surfaces

implementation.buttons: Use framed gold primary buttons, fine outline secondary buttons, centered labels, and pressed states that feel like a mechanical latch.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用金色框线主按钮、细描边次按钮、居中标签，以及像机械扣件一样明确的按下态。
implementation.feedback: Use polished labels, reserved alert strips, invitation confirmations, and availability states aligned to the poster axis.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用精致标签、克制提示条、邀请确认和沿海报轴线对齐的可用状态。
implementation.spacing: Use 24-34px ceremonial panels, tight 8-12px label gaps, and generous space around the headline and reservation action.
implementation.zhSpacing: 仪式化面板内边距 24-34px，标签间距 8-12px，标题和预订操作周围保留充足空间。
implementation.responsive: Desktop can use symmetry and side proof panels; mobile keeps the monogram, headline, primary action, availability, then room details in one centered stack.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可使用对称和侧边证明面板；手机按字标、标题、主操作、可用性、房间详情的顺序居中堆叠。

adaptation.landing: Use a symmetrical event or venue poster with gilded proof, availability, refined offer copy, and one ceremonial booking action.
adaptation.dashboard: Use sparingly for concierge, venue, or premium booking dashboards where room status and appointments are the main objects.
adaptation.admin: Use for curated hospitality/event operations only; keep tables simplified and avoid ornamental bulk-action clutter.
adaptation.forms: Use short reservation forms, visible labels, elegant validation, and framed confirmation states.
adaptation.mobile: Order as monogram, offer, primary booking action, availability, room proof, then secondary story.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for dense operational tools, casual consumer apps, and utilitarian admin pages.

styles.name: Wabi-Sabi
styles.brief: Earthy restraint, natural texture, handmade imperfection, quiet whitespace, and slow material confidence.
styles.zhBrief: 低饱和大地色、自然纹理、手作不完美、安静留白和缓慢的材质信任感。
styles.bestFor: ceramics, wellness, slow commerce, craft portfolios, mindful editorial pages
styles.zhBestFor: 陶艺、健康生活、慢电商、手作作品集、安静编辑页
notes: Let asymmetry feel found and intentional, not careless.
Use texture and edge softness instead of bright decoration.
Leave enough silence around product objects, quotes, and primary actions.

scenario.lede: A wabi-sabi studio page for ceramic repairs, object intake, care notes, process journals, and small workshop visits.
features: Repair table
Objects, cracks, slips, and care notes create the layout language.
Useful imperfection
Irregular shapes are tied to real ceramic states such as drying, sealed, and reserved.
Slow conversion
The action follows trust, material notes, and process evidence.

metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.

playbook.name: Wabi Repair Studio
playbook.structure: Quiet ceramic repair table with object stage, process notes, drying ledger, care card, and grounded booking action.
playbook.zhStructure: 安静陶瓷修补台，包含对象台、过程说明、干燥账页、养护卡和踏实预约操作。
playbook.typography: Use warm body text, small honest labels, and enough whitespace around each object.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用温暖正文、小而真实的标签，并给每个对象留足空白。
playbook.components: Crack diagrams, clay bodies, cure timing, repair status, and care notes should feel handmade but aligned.
playbook.zhComponents: 裂纹图、陶土、固化时间、修补状态和养护说明要有手作感但保持对齐。
playbook.buttons: Use quiet grounded buttons that become precise on focus or selected state.
playbook.zhButtons: 使用安静踏实的按钮，并在焦点或选中态变得明确。
playbook.media: Use ceramic forms, repair seams, worktable marks, clay labels, and care cards.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用陶瓷形态、修补线、工作台痕迹、陶土标签和养护卡。
playbook.states: Show drying, curing, ready, reserved, care needed, and repaired states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 drying、curing、ready、reserved、care needed 和 repaired 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not polish away the material irregularity.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要把材质不规则感全部磨掉。

geometry.description: quiet handmade geometry with small irregular-feeling corners

implementation.buttons: Use quiet text or low-fill buttons with visible focus, modest hover, and selected states that feel gently pressed into paper.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用安静文字或低填充按钮，保留可见焦点、克制 hover，并让选中态像轻轻压入纸面。
implementation.feedback: Use small inline notes, care labels, reserved marks, and calm confirmations near the affected object.
implementation.zhFeedback: 在对象附近使用小型内联说明、养护标签、预留标记和平静确认。
implementation.spacing: Use 28-44px quiet gutters, uneven but intentional object spacing, and 14-18px readable caption gaps.
implementation.zhSpacing: 安静留白 28-44px，对象间距可不完全均匀但要有意图，图注间距 14-18px。
implementation.responsive: Desktop may place one object stage beside notes; mobile shows object, material caption, availability, then action without crowding.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可让对象舞台和说明并列；手机按对象、材质图注、可用状态、操作顺序呈现，避免拥挤。

adaptation.landing: Use one material object, generous space, process notes, human copy, and a slow primary action after proof.
adaptation.dashboard: Use for studio inventory, wellness progress, or small collections where low density and material context matter.
adaptation.admin: Use only for calm curation or catalog management; avoid high-volume tables and urgent batch operations.
adaptation.forms: Use few fields, grounded labels, quiet helper text, and validation that stays close to the field.
adaptation.mobile: Show object, caption, status, care/process note, then action; preserve whitespace instead of squeezing more modules in.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for urgent alerts, high-density analytics, loud campaigns, or glossy tech launches.

styles.name: Ink Wash
styles.brief: Paper-white canvas, black ink hierarchy, red seal accents, scroll rhythm, and poetic editorial restraint.
styles.zhBrief: 宣纸白底、墨色层级、朱红印章强调、卷轴节奏和诗性编辑克制。
styles.bestFor: tea culture, museums, literature, cultural ecommerce, heritage product stories
styles.zhBestFor: 茶文化、博物馆、文学、文化电商、传统产品叙事
notes: Treat black, gray, and blank paper as the main palette.
Use red only as a seal, warning, or decisive action accent.
Do not turn the page into a generic Asian decorative collage.

scenario.lede: An ink-wash editorial commerce page for tea origin notes, tasting records, mountain lots, seals, and restrained product proof.

Story, lot ledger, and tasting note unfold vertically like a quiet product record.
Seal semantics
Red is reserved for chosen lot, provenance proof, and decisive action.
Cultural restraint
Ink, blank paper, and source notes carry information instead of decoration.

launch: Tasting scroll

playbook.name: Ink Tea Scroll
playbook.structure: Scroll-like tea origin page with ink landscape, lot ledger, tasting notes, provenance seal, and quiet commerce path.
playbook.zhStructure: 卷轴式茶源页，包含水墨山场、批次账页、品饮记录、出处印章和安静购买路径。
playbook.typography: Use brush-like moments only for headings or seals; keep body copy disciplined and readable.
playbook.zhTypography: 书写感只用于标题或印章，正文保持克制可读。
playbook.components: Origin notes, tea lots, tasting rows, seal states, and source strips should feel archival.
playbook.zhComponents: 产地说明、茶批次、品饮行、印章状态和来源条要有档案感。
playbook.buttons: Primary actions can read like a seal; secondary actions should be text or rule-line controls.
playbook.zhButtons: 主操作可像印章，次操作应使用文字或规则线控件。
playbook.media: Use paper, mist, ink fields, tea lot rows, red seals, and tasting notes.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用纸、雾、墨场、茶批次行、朱印和品饮记录。
playbook.states: Show selected lot, saved note, source seal, archived, warning, and tasting open states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 selected lot、saved note、source seal、archived、warning 和 tasting open 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not use decorative cultural symbols without structure.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要使用没有结构价值的文化装饰符号。

geometry.description: paper-and-rule geometry with seals and scroll-like edges

implementation.buttons: Use seal-like primary actions, underlined text actions, and square focus states that preserve the paper rhythm.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用印章式主操作、下划线文字操作，以及保持纸面节奏的方形焦点态。
implementation.feedback: Use red seal confirmations, margin notes, rule-separated warnings, and source-open indicators.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用朱红印章确认、边注、规则线分隔警告和来源打开指示。
implementation.spacing: Use wide paper margins, strict vertical rhythm, thin rule lines, and generous caption spacing.
implementation.zhSpacing: 使用宽纸面边距、严格纵向节奏、细规则线和充足图注间距。
implementation.responsive: Desktop can keep metadata, lead story, and index columns; mobile preserves scroll order with seal action after the title and source notes after the content.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面可保留元信息、主叙事和索引列；手机保持卷轴阅读顺序，标题后放印章操作，内容后放来源说明。

adaptation.landing: Use a scroll-like editorial sequence with origin, source notes, product proof, and seal-like primary action.
adaptation.dashboard: Use only for cultural archives, catalog review, or editorial systems where index rows and provenance matter.
adaptation.admin: Use for museum, publishing, or cultural ecommerce back offices with careful metadata, not generic CRUD shells.
adaptation.forms: Use persistent labels, margin notes, rule-line validation, and a red seal only for decisive states.
adaptation.mobile: Preserve reading order as scroll sections: title, seal action, story, proof, index, source notes.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for modern SaaS metrics, playful apps, or pages that need heavy chart density.

styles.name: Blueprint
styles.brief: Deep blue technical grid, cyan linework, annotated structure, measured components, and plan-sheet precision.
styles.zhBrief: 深蓝技术网格、青色线稿、标注结构、测量式组件和工程图纸精度。
styles.bestFor: architecture tools, renovation planning, systems maps, technical plans
styles.zhBestFor: 建筑工具、改造规划、系统地图、技术图纸
notes: Use grid, scale, labels, and dimension lines as real information structure.
Keep linework thin and exact instead of glowing like a sci-fi console.
Make annotations explain relationships, ownership, and next actions.

scenario.headline: Measure a live-work loft before the first wall is moved.
scenario.lede: A blueprint page for apartment renovation, built-in furniture, lighting runs, contractor notes, and measured room decisions.
features: Measured living
Dimensions, furniture blocks, and lighting runs are part of the UI, not background texture.
Build clarity
Crew notes, room callouts, and unresolved spans stay attached to the plan.
Plan-sheet precision
The layout feels technical while remaining about a real home.

launch: Plan approval
Arrange the main object, decision path, and supporting details before polishing the style.
metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.
assets: Room and material drawings
Use visual objects that belong to the scene so the sample feels lived-in and useful.

playbook.name: Blueprint Renovation Sheet
playbook.structure: Home renovation plan sheet with room dimensions, furniture blocks, lighting runs, material callouts, and crew notes.
playbook.zhStructure: 家居改造图纸，包含房间尺寸、家具块、灯线、材料标注和施工说明。
playbook.typography: Use compact technical labels, tabular dimensions, and clear sheet titles.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用紧凑技术标签、表格尺寸和清楚图纸标题。
playbook.components: Dimension lines, room nodes, fixture labels, unresolved spans, export controls, and material notes should be measured.
playbook.zhComponents: 尺寸线、房间节点、灯具标签、未决跨度、导出控件和材料说明要有测量感。
playbook.buttons: Use technical annotation controls with thin borders and clear focus.
playbook.zhButtons: 使用技术标注式控件，细边框且焦点清晰。
playbook.media: Use room plans, section marks, furniture outlines, lighting routes, and material callouts.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用房间平面、剖面标记、家具轮廓、灯线路径和材料标注。
playbook.states: Show measured, approved, revise, open note, blocked span, and exported states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 measured、approved、revise、open note、blocked span 和 exported 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not turn blueprint precision into generic sci-fi glow.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要把蓝图精度做成通用科幻发光。

geometry.description: technical plan-sheet geometry with measured low-radius panels

implementation.buttons: Use compact command buttons, coordinate chips, thin measured borders, and active states that look selected on a drawing sheet.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用紧凑命令按钮、坐标 chip、细测量边框，以及像图纸中选中对象的 active 状态。
implementation.feedback: Use callout notes, dimension-line warnings, export confirmations, and blocked-span labels tied to exact nodes.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用标注说明、尺寸线警告、导出确认和绑定到具体节点的阻塞跨度标签。
implementation.spacing: Use 16-24px sheet panels, 8-12px annotation gaps, thin grid lines, and dense but aligned metric rows.
implementation.zhSpacing: 图纸面板 16-24px，标注间距 8-12px，细网格线，指标密集但对齐。
implementation.responsive: Desktop keeps the sheet, annotations, and trace list visible; mobile shows plan summary, primary action, graph, then unresolved spans.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面保留图纸、标注和追踪列表；手机先显示计划摘要和主操作，再显示图和未解决跨度。

adaptation.landing: Use a technical plan sheet with dependency graph, annotations, export action, and engineering proof.
adaptation.dashboard: Use grid, nodes, callouts, trace rows, unresolved spans, and plan readiness metrics.
adaptation.admin: Use for infrastructure, API, architecture, and planning tools where diagrams and review gates are central.
adaptation.forms: Use compact labels, coordinate-like grouping, exact validation, and export/review confirmations.
adaptation.mobile: Show summary and action first, then graph, unresolved spans, annotations, and export details.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for soft lifestyle, emotional storytelling, and image-led luxury pages.

styles.name: Industrial Control
styles.brief: Rugged dark panels, safety accents, dense status rows, machine labels, and maintainable control-room clarity.
styles.zhBrief: 耐用暗色面板、安全色强调、密集状态行、机器标签和可维护的控制室清晰度。
styles.bestFor: print rooms, factory monitoring, logistics control, hardware fleets, incident rooms
styles.zhBestFor: 印刷工作室、工厂监控、物流控制、硬件设备队列、事故指挥室
notes: Prioritize durable controls, visible warnings, and operator scan speed.
Use color as safety semantics, not decorative variety.
Keep layouts serviceable: labels, owners, thresholds, and recovery actions must be obvious.

scenario.headline: Run a letterpress shift through ink, plates, rollers, and cleanup.
scenario.lede: An industrial control page for a working print studio with press status, ink batches, drying racks, safety lockouts, and service evidence.
features: Shop-floor density
Line cards, alarms, ink batches, and service notes stay visible for fast scanning.
Safety color
Amber, red, green, and neutral states map to real press-room meaning.
Rugged craft
The page feels industrial without becoming a factory clone.

launch: Shift triage
Arrange the main object, decision path, and supporting details before polishing the style.
metrics: Track the few signals that matter to this specific page instead of filling space with generic KPIs.
assets: Ink and service evidence
Use visual objects that belong to the scene so the sample feels lived-in and useful.

playbook.name: Industrial Print Room
playbook.structure: Rugged print-studio control room with press matrix, ink batch table, drying rack, safety hold, cleanup log, and service evidence.
playbook.zhStructure: 耐用印刷工作室控制室，包含印刷机矩阵、油墨批次表、晾干架、安全暂停、清洁日志和维修证据。
playbook.typography: Use rugged UI type, tabular machine values, short state names, and strong row scanning.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用耐用界面字体、表格式机器数值、短状态名和强行扫描。
playbook.components: Press cards, ink rows, lockout notes, rack meters, service tags, and acknowledgement buttons should feel shop-floor ready.
playbook.zhComponents: 印刷机卡、油墨行、锁定说明、晾干架仪表、维修标签和确认按钮要适合车间使用。
playbook.buttons: Use durable rectangular controls; warning and acknowledgement states must be unmistakable.
playbook.zhButtons: 使用耐用矩形控件；警告和确认态必须明确。
playbook.media: Use press labels, ink batches, roller checks, drying racks, service logs, and safety notes.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用印刷机标签、油墨批次、滚筒检查、晾干架、维修日志和安全说明。
playbook.states: Show hold, mixing, open, locked out, recovered, warning, and acknowledged states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 hold、mixing、open、locked out、recovered、warning 和 acknowledged 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not soften safety-critical craft operations into glossy consumer UI.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要把安全关键的手作运营软化成亮面消费 UI。

geometry.description: rugged industrial geometry with hard serviceable controls

implementation.buttons: Use hard rectangular controls, explicit acknowledgement buttons, safety-color destructive states, and disabled states that look locked out.
implementation.zhButtons: 使用硬朗矩形控件、明确确认按钮、安全色危险态，以及像 lockout 的禁用态。
implementation.feedback: Use alarm banners, row-local warnings, service-log confirmations, and recovery actions attached to the affected machine.
implementation.zhFeedback: 使用告警 banner、行内警告、维修日志确认，以及绑定到受影响机器的恢复操作。
implementation.spacing: Use 16-22px rugged panels, 8-10px dense status rows, 44-52px control heights, and compact filter rails.
implementation.zhSpacing: 耐用面板 16-22px，密集状态行 8-10px，控件高度 44-52px，筛选栏紧凑。
implementation.responsive: Desktop keeps filters, alarms, metrics, and inspector visible; mobile shows alarm summary, acknowledge action, filters, then service detail.
implementation.zhResponsive: 桌面保留筛选、告警、指标和检查面板；手机先显示告警摘要和确认操作，再显示筛选和维修详情。

adaptation.landing: Use a rugged operations story only when the public page is about equipment, reliability, service, or safety proof.
adaptation.dashboard: Use alarms, filters, threshold metrics, service queues, ownership chips, and row-local recovery actions.
adaptation.admin: Use for operations consoles, hardware fleets, logistics control, safety checks, and service management.
adaptation.forms: Use clear labels, hard field borders, machine IDs, explicit validation, and locked/destructive confirmations.
adaptation.mobile: Show alarm summary, acknowledge action, active filters, alarm list, and service detail in that order.
adaptation.unsuitable: Weak for luxury editorial, calm wellness, playful education, or long-form reading.

playbook.name: Minimal Command Workspace
playbook.structure: Command-first workspace with a large prompt bar, result pane, run history, review notes, and compact evidence rows.
playbook.zhStructure: 命令优先工作区，包含大提示栏、结果面、运行历史、审阅笔记和紧凑证据行。
playbook.typography: Use readable UI type with monospace fragments, crisp labels, and restrained heading scale.
playbook.zhTypography: 使用易读界面字体、等宽片段、清晰标签和克制标题层级。
playbook.components: Prompt bar, generated result, run rows, code fragments, review chips, and save states should feel like a real tool.
playbook.zhComponents: 提示栏、生成结果、运行行、代码片段、审阅 chip 和保存状态应像真实工具。
playbook.buttons: Buttons are simple and sharp; primary action is solid, secondary actions are text or light outlines.
playbook.zhButtons: 按钮简洁利落；主操作实色，次级操作用文字或轻描边。
playbook.media: Use code snippets, output excerpts, diffs, or command history instead of decorative screenshots.
playbook.zhMedia: 使用代码片段、输出摘录、diff 或命令历史，不使用装饰截图。
playbook.states: Show running, accepted, review due, saved, blocked, and disabled submit states.
playbook.zhStates: 呈现 running、accepted、review due、saved、blocked 和 disabled submit 状态。
playbook.avoid: Do not add decorative gradients to compensate for weak content hierarchy.
playbook.zhAvoid: 不要用装饰渐变弥补内容层级薄弱。
